name: latest
description: Takes the most recent value of an argument from the logs that record a state change, optionally per key. Exists for state that is overwritten (current owner, current config, owner per token id) where V1 used an `event` handler with `set`, with or without `groupBy`. Replaces the V1 `event` handler used with `set`.
input: The result of a `logs` fetch: decoded logs `[{ event, blockNumber, logIndex, args }]` in chain order.

value.description: Name of the event argument holding the new value, e.g. `newOwner`.

set.description: Rules selecting the logs that write the value.

when.description: Optional filter: only logs where `args[arg]` equals `equals` (inverted by `negate`).

equals.description: Literal to compare against, any JSON value.

groupBy.description: Optional event argument to key by (e.g. `tokenId`). When given, the output is an object with the latest value per distinct key.

output: Without `groupBy`: `args[value]` of the last matching log, or null when none matched. With `groupBy`: an object keyed by the string form of `args[groupBy]` (tuples joined with `,`) holding the last `args[value]` seen for that key.
